                    local keyValue = tostring(optionValue)
                    selected[keyValue] = not selected[keyValue]

                    if not selected[keyValue] then
                        selected[keyValue] = nil
                    end

                    refreshSummary()
                    refreshOptions()
                    emit()
                end)
            end

            refreshSummary()
            refreshOptions()
        end

        local function applySearch()
            local query = string.lower(search.Text or "")

            for optionValue, data in pairs(optionRows) do
                data.Row.Visible =
                    query == ""
                    or string.find(
                        string.lower(tostring(optionValue)),
                        query,
                        1,
                        true
                    ) ~= nil
            end
        end

        search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(applySearch)

        allButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not enabled then
                return
            end

            for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                selected[tostring(optionValue)] = true
            end

            refreshSummary()
            refreshOptions()
            emit()
        end)

        clearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not enabled then
                return
            end

            table.clear(selected)
            refreshSummary()
            refreshOptions()
            emit()
        end)

        function item:Open()
            if open or not enabled then
                return
            end

            closeOtherPicker(item)
            Window._OpenPicker = item
            open = true

            menu.Visible = true
            arrow.Text = "^"

            local optionCount = math.clamp(#values,2,6)
            local menuHeight = 51 + (optionCount * 35)

            menu.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,menuHeight)

            Tween(row,.17,{
                Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,closedHeight + menuHeight + 10)
            })

            Tween(selectorStroke,.13,{
                Color = accent,
                Transparency = .38,
            })

            task.defer(function()
                if search.Parent and options.AutoFocusSearch then
                    search:CaptureFocus()
                end
            end)
        end

        function item:Close()
            if not open then
                return
            end

            open = false

            if Window._OpenPicker == item then
                Window._OpenPicker = nil
            end

            arrow.Text = "v"
            search.Text = ""

            Tween(row,.15,{
                Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,closedHeight)
            })

            Tween(selectorStroke,.13,{
                Color = Theme.StrokeSoft,
                Transparency = .72,
            })

            task.delay(.15,function()
                if not open and menu.Parent then
                    menu.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end

        function item:Get()
            return selectedList(values,selected)
        end

        function item:GetSet()
            local result = {}
            for keyValue, on in pairs(selected) do
                if on then
                    result[keyValue] = true
                end
            end
            return result
        end

        function item:Set(newSelection,silent)
            selected = makeSet(newSelection)

            -- Remove values that are not in the current options.
            local allowed = {}
            for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                allowed[tostring(optionValue)] = true
            end

            for keyValue in pairs(selected) do
                if not allowed[keyValue] then
                    selected[keyValue] = nil
                end
            end

            refreshSummary()
            refreshOptions()

            if not silent and callback then
                task.spawn(
                    callback,
                    selectedList(values,selected),
                    selected
                )
            end
        end

        function item:Clear(silent)
            item:Set({},silent)
        end

        function item:SelectAll(silent)
            local all = {}
            for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                all[#all + 1] = optionValue
            end
            item:Set(all,silent)
        end

        function item:SetEnabled(newEnabled)
            enabled = newEnabled ~= false
            selector.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and .47 or .78
            summary.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or .50

            if not enabled then
                item:Close()
            end
        end

        function item:SetOptions(newValues,preserve)
            local previous = item:GetSet()
            values = copyArray(newValues)

            if preserve then
                selected = previous
            else
                selected = {}
            end

            -- Remove invalid selections.
            local allowed = {}
            for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                allowed[tostring(optionValue)] = true
            end

            for keyValue in pairs(selected) do
                if not allowed[keyValue] then
                    selected[keyValue] = nil
                end
            end

            rebuild()
            applySearch()
        end

        Overlay(selector,function()
            if open then
                item:Close()
            else
                item:Open()
            end
        end,30)

        rebuild()
        Window.Items[key] = item
        return item
    end

    function Window:Input(parent, key, title, description, default, callback, options)
        options = options or {}
        local row = baseRow(parent,60)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,7),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,20),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,28),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,18),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = tostring(description or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        local box = New("TextBox", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),
            Size = UDim2.new(.50,0,0,36),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency = .47,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            PlaceholderText = tostring(options.Placeholder or ""),
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Text = tostring(default or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Cyan,
            TextSize = 10,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(box,9)
        Stroke(box,Theme.StrokeSoft,.72,1)

        New("UIPadding", {
            PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,10),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,10),
            Parent = box,
        })

        local item = {}
        local value = default

        local function sanitize(raw)
            if options.Numeric then
                local number = tonumber(raw)
                if number == nil then
                    return value
                end

                if options.Min ~= nil then
                    number = math.max(tonumber(options.Min) or number,number)
                end

                if options.Max ~= nil then
                    number = math.min(tonumber(options.Max) or number,number)
                end

                if options.Integer then
                    number = math.floor(number + .5)
                end

                return number
            end

            return tostring(raw or "")
        end

        function item:Set(newValue,silent)
            value = sanitize(newValue)
            box.Text = tostring(value or "")

            if not silent and callback then
                task.spawn(callback,value)
            end
        end

        function item:Get()
            return value
        end

        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
            item:Set(box.Text,false)
        end)

        Window.Items[key] = item
        return item
    end



    function Window:Progress(parent, key, title, description, value, options)
        options = options or {}

        local row = baseRow(parent,68)
        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent or "cyan")
        local minimum = tonumber(options.Min) or 0
        local maximum = tonumber(options.Max) or 100

        if maximum <= minimum then
            maximum = minimum + 1
        end

        local current = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or minimum,minimum,maximum)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,6),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-96,0,20),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        if description and description ~= "" then
            New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,25),
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-96,0,16),
                Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                Text = tostring(description),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                TextSize = 8,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 18,
                Parent = row,
            })
        end

        local valueLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,0,7),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76,18),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = accent,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        local bar = New("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,50),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,7),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Track,
            BackgroundTransparency = .18,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(bar,999)

        local fill = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0),
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = bar,
        })
        Round(fill,999)

        local item = {}

        local function formatValue(v)
            if type(options.Format) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(options.Format,v,minimum,maximum)
                if ok then
                    return tostring(result)
                end
            end

            if options.Percent ~= false then
                local alpha = (v-minimum)/(maximum-minimum)
                return tostring(math.floor(alpha*100 + .5)) .. "%"
            end

            return tostring(math.floor(v + .5)) .. tostring(options.Suffix or "")
        end

        function item:Set(newValue)
            current = math.clamp(
                tonumber(newValue) or current,
                minimum,
                maximum
            )

            local alpha = (current-minimum)/(maximum-minimum)

            Tween(fill,.16,{
                Size = UDim2.new(alpha,0,1,0)
            })

            valueLabel.Text = formatValue(current)
        end

        function item:Get()
            return current
        end

        item:Set(current)

        if key then
            Window.Items[key] = item
        end

        return item
    end

    function Window:Hero(parent, kicker, title, description, accentName)
        local row = baseRow(parent,112)
        local color = accentName == "mint"
            and Theme.Mint
            or accentName == "lavender"
            and Theme.Lavender
            or Theme.Cyan

        local line = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3=color,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
            Size=UDim2.new(0,3,1,0),
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row
        })
        Round(line,999)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,10),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,18),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text=kicker or "",
            TextColor3=color,
            TextSize=10,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,31),
